name: When It Rains
source:
Explore a conservatory on a dark, rainy day to help a (sorta) grandpa (sorta) vampire (sorta) find his stolen memory!

[From [url=https://kzel.itch.io/rain]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在陰沉的雨天裡，探索一座溫室，幫一位（姑且算是）爺爺、（姑且算是）吸血鬼的傢伙，（姑且算是）找回他被偷走的記憶！
